text: I feel the tension between creation and contemplation here. In the first space, the glass wall separates me from the engaged discussions and exchange of ideas—a reminder of the boundaries that both isolate and protect the life of the mind. In the second, the colorful wall and R+D motif evoke a spirit of experimentation and possibility. I feel energized by the nearness of intellectual labor, but also aware of how easy it is to become an observer rather than a participant. Curiosity and slight restlessness intermingle within me.
